notes: DCA prospective need was 195; Borough successfully challenged to 179 (settlement with NJBA and Incandescent Development, Order May 19 2025, Docket BER-L-719-25). Present need 49 accepted. RDP=10, unmet need 169. Plan addresses 10 RDP + 42 of 169 unmet need units through 4 Fourth Round mechanisms (Forcellati inclusionary site, Collignon Estates, OL downtown overlay) plus group homes. Present need met via Bergen County Rehabilitation Program (3-year cooperative agreement). Prepared by H2M architects+engineers. Planning Board adopted June 18, 2025; Council endorsed June 23, 2025.
